Do I get this right that this validation is only done along execution and not yet on block creation? If so: is there a reason to allow this? correct. the reason is the sender paid for it so they are incentivized to not post junk to the chain no need to further complicate tx validity does anyone know if cross-client benchmarks (implemented as state tests) exist for eip2537?

excerpts.content:
<@543900561460822016> Quick 7702 question:

> Verify the chain id is either 0 or the chain’s current ID.

Do I get this right that this validation is only done along execution and not yet on block creation? So a block with a 7702 tx with an authorization list item with a non-matching chain ID would therefore still be valid and included in the chain? If so: is there a reason to allow this?

excerpts.author: lightclient
excerpts.content: correct. the reason is the sender paid for it so they are incentivized to not post junk to the chain

excerpts.author: lightclient
excerpts.content: no need to further complicate tx validity
